acceptance_criteria: A 'Gebärde' control appears on the board only when the active profile has usable examples; the camera starts only after a tap; the attempt is recorded after a short countdown until a tap or a time limit, with the same capture path as teaching
A recognised concept is shown large with its symbol and label and 'Ja, sagen' and 'Nein'; speech happens only after 'Ja, sagen', through the board's existing speech path and sentence bar

An unknown result speaks nothing, says in German that it was not understood, and shows up to three candidate tiles (tapping one speaks it like a board tile) and 'Zurück zur Tafel'; unusable recordings are refused with the reason
One- and two-hand gestures are recognised against examples of the same kind; the camera stops on every way out and after each attempt; nothing is stored or sent
A real-browser test teaches examples from DGS videos and attempts gestures from the same videos through the board's own flow, and checks that a confirmed result speaks and an unconfirmed one does not
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: On the child's board a tap starts a gesture attempt; the app matches it against that child's taught examples and shows what it understood, and speaks only after a confirming tap; an unknown gesture shows up to three candidates and the way back to the board, and nothing is spoken by itself.
